expectations.criterion: Sets and restores explicit logical viewport, pixel-ratio, and inset test state using the supplied project-compatible APIs.
expectations.evidence: Sets tester.view.devicePixelRatio to 1, physicalSize to each explicit logical size, and viewInsets using FakeViewPadding; registers tester.view.reset with addTearDown. Uses TextScaler.linear for enlarged text.

expectations.criterion: Uses deterministic named fixtures and a bounded risk-based combination matrix rather than device names or a full Cartesian product.
expectations.evidence: Defines six named scenarios with baseline size coverage and concentrated compact stress cases. Requires fixed translated content, seeded validation state, and a fake submission dependency.

expectations.criterion: Checks relevant overflow, geometry containment, scrolling, and hit-test behavior and separates widget-test evidence from golden or real-device evidence.
expectations.evidence: Checks framework exceptions, visible-region containment, field/action overlap, scrolling to errors and controls, action hit-testability, and observable tap results. Explicitly distinguishes simulated keyboard insets from the system keyboard and states the code has not been run against the repository.

judgment.summary: All supplied criteria are explicitly addressed through a bounded matrix, compatible state overrides and cleanup, and concrete geometry and interaction checks with clear evidence limitations.
